messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (PD#3456) - SEV2 - high packet loss observed from CDN egress at edge-pop eu-west1. Threshold breached: p50 packet loss 18% over 5m across edge-hosts [eu-west1-a,b,c]. Assigning on-call.

alice: I see it too. Synthetic checks show increased 5xx and timeouts for streaming and embeddings from EU clients. Grafana: request error rate ~12% -> 25% depending on route. Traces show TCP retransmits from eu-west1 -> upstream ISP.

ben: @alice quick checks: can you paste a failing curl + traceroute from one of the edge hosts? also any BGP flaps in the last 15m?

alice: running now on edge-eu-west1-a:
```
$ curl -s -D- -o /dev/null https://cdn.redwood.example/v1/stream
HTTP/2 502 \n...
$ traceroute -n 1.2.3.4
1  10.0.0.1  0.9 ms
2  198.51.100.2  10.7 ms
3  * * *  (packet loss)
```
No recent BGP withdraws in our feeds but ISP (AS64500) shows loss on some nexthops.

carmen: sounds like last-mile/ISP path degradation in eu-west region. Suggest immediate mitigation: shift POP traffic away from eu-west1 to eu-central1 and eu-west2 via CDN steering rules, and enable origin-failover to internal backup cluster. I can push the CDN rule; need +1 from ops.

alice: +1 for steering. Put a canary at 5% first.

ben: I'll handle BGP-level work with backbone team. Carmen, can you prepare the steering change and the config snippet? also open a routing ticket with AS path and traceroutes.

carmen: config snippet ready, pushing canary 5% -> eu-central1 now.
```
cdnctl route update --pop eu-west1 --steer-to eu-central1 --weight 5
```

incident-bot: :information_source: Change pushed by carmen at 1950004478, status: started.

alice: Canary looks good so far. Error rate for canary traffic ~1.2% (expected). Primary still noisy. Increasing to 30% to relieve load on eu-west1.

carmen: bumping to 30%.
```
cdnctl route update --pop eu-west1 --steer-to eu-central1 --weight 30
```

ben: backbone team confirms temporary blackhole on one ISP leg to eu-west1; they've announced a partial fix on their side but ETA unknown. I'm putting a /24 community to avoid that nexthop from our ASN for the affected POPs.

ben: applying route avoidance now, will monitor BGP convergence.

dave: ML endpoints (model-serving) in eu-west1 still showing nominal latencies; looks like the issue is CDN egress to internet (customer last-mile) not internal RPCs. No model rollbacks needed.

erin: coordinating with Trust & Support. Drafting customer advisory: "We're seeing degraded delivery from EU users to our CDN. We're steering traffic to alternate POPs and working with ISPs. Some requests may see increased latency or transient errors. No customer data was compromised." Want to push to status.redwood.im? Thoughts on wording?

alice: looks good, add estimated impact: ~15-25% of EU traffic affected in the last hour, now trending down to ~8% after steering.

erin: posting advisory now. Also pinging top 5 enterprise customers (via escalation list) with short note + contact.

incident-bot: :pager: On-call handoff reminder: alice -> ben in 10m unless cleared. Current incident owner: alice.

alice: handing over to @ben at 1950004520 for monitoring/mitigation. Key action items: keep steering until packet loss <3% for 10m, coordinate with backbone team for route avoidance, confirm CDNs have fallback origin healthy.

ben: taking it. I've opened ROUTE-789 and engaged ISP ops. I'll update every 10m or on any regression.

carmen: after steering to 30% we saw packet loss on eu-west1 drop from 18% -> 4% within 6m for affected prefixes. CDN 5xxs down from 22% -> 6% overall.

ben: confirmed. Running a full health sweep across edge hosts and checking customer-facing metrics. If stable for 30m we'll de-escalate.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation in place. Next automatic update in 10m.

erin: prepping follow-up CS template for account teams (short timeline, actions taken, mitigation, next steps). Will add contact info.

alice: thx all — leaving monitoring to ben. I'll be available if backbone needs topology details.

ben: thanks. logging timeline and actions to postmortem draft. Will request a post-incident review if root cause is ISP-level and recurrence risk > low.

incident-bot: Note: this thread will be archived into INC-20260315-18 after resolution."
